text: Open Sea Skin 是为 DeepSeek Harness Web 与桌面客户端提供的动态海洋外观插件。它通过 Harness Host 路由提供本地皮肤资源，并在页面中挂载共享海洋渲染器和透明玻璃样式。用户可以调整波浪强度、日光时段和界面玻璃不透明度，启用十二分钟昼夜循环、开关皮肤或恢复默认设置；界面提供中英文文案。适合希望为 Harness 工作区更换动态背景并细调外观的用户。Web 端可用 dsh plugin 命令安装，桌面端可从插件页面安装；渲染需要支持 GPU 的浏览器环境。

Open Sea Skin adds an animated ocean theme to Harness. Its Host route serves assets; a shared controller adds the renderer and glass styling. Users adjust waves, daylight, and opacity, toggle the skin, or reset settings. The panel supports Chinese and English. Install through Web or Desktop plugins.

让 Harness 的背景随昼夜自动变化。

我想在浏览器扩展里保存并同步海洋皮肤偏好。
I want an animated ocean background in my Harness workspace.
Let me adjust the waves, daylight, and glass opacity in Harness.
Can I add a bilingual theme control panel to the Harness page?
I want the ocean lighting to cycle automatically throughout the day.
Open Sea Skin 的功能「实时海洋背景」：在 Harness 页面铺设全屏海洋渲染层，以多组 Gerstner 波模拟动态海面，并绘制天空与光照。
Open Sea Skin 的功能「快速外观控制」：从皮肤设置面板调整波浪强度、日光时段和玻璃透明度，变更即时应用并保存。
Open Sea Skin 的功能「昼夜循环」：自动在十二分钟内循环日光；手动调整日光会停止自动循环，也可单独开关循环。
Open Sea Skin 的功能「本地偏好保存」：Harness 集成将设置写入 localStorage，浏览器扩展将开关、波浪、日光与玻璃设置保存到 Chrome sync storage。
Open Sea Skin 的功能「中英文控制面板」：根据页面语言显示中文或英文标签，并提供键盘 Escape 关闭与 Tab 焦点循环。
Open Sea Skin 的功能「Harness Web 静态资源路由」：插件注册 /open-sea-skin 前缀路由，读取并返回皮肤 HTML、脚本和样式资源。
Open Sea Skin 的使用须知：海洋场景使用 GPU 动态渲染，项目说明要求浏览器支持 WebGPU 或可用的 WebGL2 回退；低配设备可使用自适应分辨率与隐藏标签页暂停。
Open Sea Skin note: animated ocean rendering uses the GPU, with WebGL2 fallback and adaptive resolution.

**Open Sea Skin is an open-source ocean theme and appearance plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).** It adds a real-time WebGPU animated background, adjustable waves, daylight-to-sunset lighting, and a translucent glass interface. Use it as a DSH plugin, a Harness-only Chrome/Edge extension, or a static frontend integration.

open-sea-skin README · 🚀 Official Desktop in three steps：> Community-made, not an official DeepSeek product. This skin targets **DeepSeek Harness**, not the DeepSeek chat website. It is unrelated to the OpenSea NFT marketplace.

open-sea-skin README · 3. 🧩 Chrome / Edge extension：For local Harness pages in a browser, on Windows or Mac.

1. [Download the extension ZIP](https://github.com/d-dev0101/open-sea-skin/releases/download/v1.2.7/open-sea-skin-extension-v1.2.7.zip) and unzip it.
2. Open `chrome://extensions` or `edge://extensions`; enable **Developer mode**.
3. Choose **Load unpacked** and select the extracted folder containing `manifest.json`.
4. Reload your Harness page on `127.0.0.1` or `localhost`.

<summary>For built Harness frontends without plugin support</summary>


open-sea-skin README · 🔒 Permissions and privacy：The skin has no chat-upload or analytics feature. Installed ocean assets and fonts ship locally. The extension reads page markers to recognize Harness and changes its DOM/styles. Visual preferences use browser sync storage and may sync across devices when browser sync is enabled. The archived `site/` demo uses jsDelivr and is not the installed skin or current website. [Full privacy statement](docs/privacy.md)

open-sea-skin README · 🛠️ Built for an open ecosystem：The renderer uses **WebGPU, three.js and TSL**, with five Gerstner waves, reflections, foam and sky lighting. The canonical runtime lives in `shared/`; generated plugin, extension and static-loader copies stay synchronized. `site/` preserves the original showcase.
